```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
```

# Overview

This document runs the cross-classified random-effects model (CCREM) for the
Seoul park accessibility paper and makes all figures in R.

It includes two corrections to the earlier Python code.

1. **Age coding.** The 70+ group (`M_7000`, `W_7000`) is coded as age 75.
   The earlier code read `7000` as (70 + 0) / 2 = 35. In the figures, 65--69
   now belongs to the 60--69 group.
2. **Model terms.** Female × Age and Female × Age² are included as main
   terms. A likelihood-ratio test compares the model with and without them.

Set the paths in the `params` block at the top of this file. With
`data_source: "wide"`, the file in `wide_file` must already contain the park
variables (the merged file with 6,850 origin--park rows). With
`data_source: "long"`, the document reads `data_long_for_R.csv` from the
Python notebook.

Packages needed: `lme4`, `lmerTest`, `ggplot2`. All other steps use base R.

# 0. Setup

```{r packages}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)

# lme4 versions built for R >= 4.4 use the %||% helper, which is missing in
# R 4.3. Define it here so that VarCorr() and rePCA() print correctly.
if (!exists("%||%", mode = "function")) {
  `%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

out_dir <- params$out_dir
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

THETA <- params$theta
AMENITIES <- c("green_ratio", "user_ratio", "facility_number",
               "parking_number", "transit_number", "park_area_ha")
```

# 1. Age lookup tables

```{r age-tables}
# Age midpoint used in the regression, by the 4-digit code in the column name
AGE_MID <- c("0009" = 4.5,
             "1014" = 12, "1519" = 17,
             "2024" = 22, "2529" = 27,
             "3034" = 32, "3539" = 37,
             "4044" = 42, "4549" = 47,
             "5054" = 52, "5559" = 57,
             "6064" = 62, "6569" = 67,
             "7000" = 75)            # open band 70+

# Ten-year group used in the figures
AGE_LABEL <- c("0009" = "0-9",
               "1014" = "10-19", "1519" = "10-19",
               "2024" = "20-29", "2529" = "20-29",
               "3034" = "30-39", "3539" = "30-39",
               "4044" = "40-49", "4549" = "40-49",
               "5054" = "50-59", "5559" = "50-59",
               "6064" = "60-69", "6569" = "60-69",
               "7000" = "70+")
LABEL_ORDER <- c("0-9", "10-19", "20-29", "30-39",
                 "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70+")

# Ages at which marginal effects are reported
ME_AGES <- c("0-9" = 5, "10-19" = 15, "20-29" = 25, "30-39" = 35,
             "40-49" = 45, "50-59" = 55, "60-69" = 65, "70+" = 75)
```

# 2. Build the long data

```{r build-data}
if (params$data_source == "wide") {

  wide <- read.csv(params$wide_file, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  group_cols <- grep("^[MW]_[0-9]{4}$", names(wide), value = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(group_cols) == 28)

  # Park variables (same definitions as the paper, Table 1)
  wide$green_ratio <- wide$greenarea_area / wide$park_area * 100
  wide$user_ratio  <- (wide$openspaace_area + wide$road_area +
                       wide$walkingtrail_area + wide$shadecanopy_area) /
                      wide$park_area * 100
  wide$facility_number <- wide$gymtrack_number + wide$swimmingpool_number +
                          wide$sportsfacility_number + wide$playground_number +
                          wide$cafeteria_number + wide$kiosk_number
  wide$parking_number <- wide$parkingcapacity_number
  wide$transit_number <- wide$bus500 + wide$sub500
  wide$park_area_ha   <- wide$park_area / 10000

  cat("Parks:", length(unique(wide$ID)),
      "| Origin gu:", length(unique(wide$INFLOW_CD)),
      "| Origin-park pairs:", nrow(wide), "\n")

  # Wide -> long: one row per origin-park pair and sex-age group
  keep <- c("INFLOW_CD", "ID", "c_eq_min", AMENITIES)
  dl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(group_cols, function(g) {
    data.frame(wide[, keep], group = g, visitors = wide[[g]])
  }))
  cat("Rows before removing zero cells:", nrow(dl), "\n")
  dl <- dl[dl$visitors > 0, ]
  cat("Rows after removing zero cells: ", nrow(dl), "\n")

  # Sex and age from the column name, using the lookup tables
  code <- sub("^[MW]_", "", dl$group)
  stopifnot(all(code %in% names(AGE_MID)))
  dl$female    <- as.integer(substr(dl$group, 1, 1) == "W")
  dl$age       <- unname(AGE_MID[code])
  dl$age_label <- unname(AGE_LABEL[code])

  # Check: 70+ must be 75
  check <- unique(dl[, c("group", "female", "age", "age_label")])
  print(check[order(check$female, check$age), ], row.names = FALSE)
  stopifnot(all(check$age[grepl("7000$", check$group)] == 75))

  AGE_MEAN <- mean(dl$age)
  dl$age_c    <- dl$age - AGE_MEAN
  dl$age_c_sq <- dl$age_c^2
  dl$w        <- dl$visitors / mean(dl$visitors)   # weights rescaled to mean 1

} else {

  dl <- read.csv(params$long_file)
  # age_c was centered in Python; recover the raw age from the smallest value,
  # which belongs to the 0-9 band (midpoint 4.5)
  AGE_MEAN <- 4.5 - min(dl$age_c)
  dl$age <- round(dl$age_c + AGE_MEAN, 2)
  stopifnot(all(dl$age %in% AGE_MID))
  dl$age_label <- unname(AGE_LABEL[match(dl$age, AGE_MID)])
  dl$age_c_sq <- dl$age_c^2
}

cat("Sample mean age used for centering:", round(AGE_MEAN, 3), "\n")
cat("Observations:", nrow(dl), "\n")
```

# 3. Interaction terms

```{r interactions}
dl$female_age  <- dl$female * dl$age_c
dl$female_age2 <- dl$female * dl$age_c_sq
for (a in AMENITIES) {
  dl[[paste0(a, "_F")]]   <- dl[[a]] * dl$female
  dl[[paste0(a, "_A")]]   <- dl[[a]] * dl$age_c
  dl[[paste0(a, "_A2")]]  <- dl[[a]] * dl$age_c_sq
  dl[[paste0(a, "_FA")]]  <- dl[[a]] * dl$female * dl$age_c
  dl[[paste0(a, "_FA2")]] <- dl[[a]] * dl$female * dl$age_c_sq
}

DEMO_TERMS <- c("female", "age_c", "age_c_sq", "female_age", "female_age2")
AMEN_TERMS <- c(AMENITIES,
                paste0(AMENITIES, "_F"),  paste0(AMENITIES, "_A"),
                paste0(AMENITIES, "_A2"), paste0(AMENITIES, "_FA"),
                paste0(AMENITIES, "_FA2"))
FIXED_TERMS <- c(DEMO_TERMS, AMEN_TERMS)

dl$ID        <- factor(dl$ID)
dl$INFLOW_CD <- factor(dl$INFLOW_CD)

f_full <- as.formula(paste("c_eq_min ~", paste(FIXED_TERMS, collapse = " + "),
                           "+ (1|ID) + (1|INFLOW_CD)"))
f_noFA <- as.formula(paste("c_eq_min ~",
                           paste(setdiff(FIXED_TERMS, c("female_age", "female_age2")),
                                 collapse = " + "),
                           "+ (1|ID) + (1|INFLOW_CD)"))
cat("Fixed-effect terms:", length(FIXED_TERMS), "\n")
```

# 4. Variance inflation factors

```{r vif}
# VIF_j = 1 / (1 - R2_j), where R2_j comes from regressing term j on the others
vif_manual <- function(X) {
  X <- as.data.frame(X)
  sapply(names(X), function(v) {
    r2 <- summary(lm(X[[v]] ~ ., data = X[setdiff(names(X), v)]))$r.squared
    1 / (1 - r2)
  })
}

vif_main <- vif_manual(dl[, c("female", "age_c", "age_c_sq", AMENITIES)])
vif_full <- vif_manual(dl[, FIXED_TERMS])

vif_tab <- data.frame(term = names(vif_full), VIF_full = round(vif_full, 2))
vif_tab$VIF_main_design <- round(vif_main[vif_tab$term], 2)
vif_tab <- vif_tab[order(-vif_tab$VIF_full), ]
write.csv(vif_tab, file.path(out_dir, "vif.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Amenity VIFs, main-effects design:\n"); print(round(vif_main[AMENITIES], 2))
cat("\nTen highest VIFs, full design:\n");   print(head(vif_tab[, 1:2], 10), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 5. Fit the CCREM

This chunk can take several minutes.

```{r fit-ccrem}
ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
fit <- lmer(f_full, data = dl, weights = w, REML = TRUE, control = ctrl)

cat("isSingular:", isSingular(fit), "\n\n")
print(VarCorr(fit))
cat("\n")
print(summary(rePCA(fit)))
```

## Optimizer check

```{r optimizer-check, eval = params$run_optimizer_check}
fit_nm <- update(fit, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead",
                                            optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
cat("Max abs difference in fixed effects (BOBYQA vs Nelder-Mead):",
    signif(max(abs(fixef(fit) - fixef(fit_nm))), 3), "\n")
cat("logLik BOBYQA:", as.numeric(logLik(fit)),
    "| logLik Nelder-Mead:", as.numeric(logLik(fit_nm)), "\n")
```

## Likelihood-ratio test for Female × Age and Female × Age²

```{r lrt, eval = params$run_lrt}
fit_noFA <- lmer(f_noFA, data = dl, weights = w, REML = TRUE, control = ctrl)
lrt <- anova(fit_noFA, fit)        # anova() refits both models with ML
print(lrt)
write.csv(as.data.frame(lrt), file.path(out_dir, "lrt_female_age.csv"))
```

# 6. Results tables

```{r results-tables}
coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(fit)$coefficients)
names(coefs) <- c("Estimate", "SE", "df", "t", "p")
coefs$term <- rownames(coefs)
stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
                     ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "")))
coefs$Sig <- stars(coefs$p)
write.csv(coefs, file.path(out_dir, "ccrem_coefficients.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

V <- as.matrix(vcov(fit))
write.csv(V, file.path(out_dir, "ccrem_vcov.csv"))

print(coefs[, c("Estimate", "SE", "t", "p", "Sig")], digits = 4)
```

## Variance components and model fit

```{r fit-stats}
vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit))
var_id  <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "ID"]
var_org <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "INFLOW_CD"]
var_res <- sigma(fit)^2
var_f   <- var(as.vector(model.matrix(fit) %*% fixef(fit)))
tot     <- var_f + var_id + var_org + var_res

fitstats <- data.frame(
  quantity = c("Park (ID) intercept variance", "Park (ID) intercept SD",
               "Origin gu (INFLOW_CD) intercept variance", "Origin gu (INFLOW_CD) intercept SD",
               "Residual variance", "Residual SD",
               "ICC park", "ICC origin",
               "Marginal R2", "Conditional R2",
               "AIC", "BIC", "logLik", "N obs", "N parks", "N origin gu"),
  value = c(var_id, sqrt(var_id), var_org, sqrt(var_org), var_res, sqrt(var_res),
            var_id / (var_id + var_org + var_res), var_org / (var_id + var_org + var_res),
            var_f / tot, (var_f + var_id + var_org) / tot,
            AIC(fit), BIC(fit), as.numeric(logLik(fit)),
            nobs(fit), nlevels(dl$ID), nlevels(dl$INFLOW_CD)))
write.csv(fitstats, file.path(out_dir, "ccrem_fit_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(fitstats, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Main effects per unit and per standard deviation

```{r std-effects}
sds <- sapply(dl[, AMENITIES], sd)
std_tab <- data.frame(
  variable    = AMENITIES,
  SD          = round(sds, 2),
  coef_unit   = round(coefs[AMENITIES, "Estimate"], 4),
  effect_SD   = round(coefs[AMENITIES, "Estimate"] * sds, 2),
  p           = round(coefs[AMENITIES, "p"], 3))
std_tab <- std_tab[order(std_tab$effect_SD), ]
write.csv(std_tab, file.path(out_dir, "std_effects.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(std_tab, row.names = FALSE)
```

## LaTeX rows for Table 3

```{r latex-rows}
tex_num <- function(x, dec = 4) {
  if (x != 0 && abs(x) < 10^(-dec)) {
    e <- floor(log10(abs(x))); m <- x / 10^e
    return(sprintf("$%.2f\\times10^{%d}$", m, e))
  }
  s <- formatC(x, format = "f", digits = dec)
  gsub("-", "$-$", s, fixed = TRUE)
}
tex_p   <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "$<$0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", p)
tex_lab <- function(t) {
  labs <- c("(Intercept)" = "Constant", female = "Female",
            age_c = "Age (centered)", age_c_sq = "Age$^2$ (centered)",
            female_age = "Female $\\times$ Age", female_age2 = "Female $\\times$ Age$^2$")
  if (t %in% names(labs)) labs[[t]] else gsub("_", "\\\\_", t)
}
sections <- list(
  "Baseline" = c("(Intercept)", DEMO_TERMS),
  "Park amenity main effects" = AMENITIES,
  "Female interactions (\\_F)" = paste0(AMENITIES, "_F"),
  "Age interactions (\\_A)" = paste0(AMENITIES, "_A"),
  "Age$^2$ interactions (\\_A2)" = paste0(AMENITIES, "_A2"),
  "Female $\\times$ Age interactions (\\_FA)" = paste0(AMENITIES, "_FA"),
  "Female $\\times$ Age$^2$ interactions (\\_FA2)" = paste0(AMENITIES, "_FA2"))
rows <- c()
for (s in names(sections)) {
  rows <- c(rows, sprintf("\\multicolumn{6}{l}{\\textit{%s}} \\\\[1pt]", s))
  for (t in sections[[s]]) {
    r <- coefs[t, ]
    rows <- c(rows, sprintf("%s & %s & %s & %s & %s & %s \\\\", tex_lab(t),
                            tex_num(r$Estimate), tex_num(r$SE), tex_num(r$t, 3),
                            tex_p(r$p), r$Sig))
  }
  rows <- c(rows, "\\midrule")
}
writeLines(head(rows, -1), file.path(out_dir, "ccrem_table_rows.tex"))
cat("Saved ccrem_table_rows.tex\n")
```

# 7. Marginal effects with delta-method confidence intervals

For men at age $a$, with $\tilde a = a - \bar a$:
$ME_M = \beta_Z + \delta_Z \tilde a + \phi_Z \tilde a^2$.
For women, the terms $\gamma_Z + \eta_Z \tilde a + \psi_Z \tilde a^2$ are
added. The Female × Age main terms do not enter, because they do not multiply
the amenity.

```{r marginal-effects}
b <- fixef(fit)

lin_comb <- function(w) {          # w: named vector of weights on coefficients
  n <- names(w)
  est <- sum(w * b[n])
  se  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(w) %*% V[n, n] %*% w))
  c(est = est, se = se)
}

me_rows <- list()
for (a in AMENITIES) {
  for (lab in names(ME_AGES)) {
    ac <- ME_AGES[[lab]] - AGE_MEAN
    wm <- setNames(c(1, ac, ac^2), paste0(a, c("", "_A", "_A2")))
    wf <- setNames(c(1, ac, ac^2), paste0(a, c("_F", "_FA", "_FA2")))
    m  <- lin_comb(wm)
    wo <- lin_comb(c(wm, wf))
    d  <- lin_comb(wf)
    me_rows[[length(me_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Amenity = a, AgeGroup = lab, Age = ME_AGES[[lab]],
      Men = m[["est"]], Men_se = m[["se"]],
      Women = wo[["est"]], Women_se = wo[["se"]],
      Diff = d[["est"]], Diff_se = d[["se"]],
      Diff_p = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(d[["est"]] / d[["se"]]))))
  }
}
me <- do.call(rbind, me_rows)
me$AgeGroup <- factor(me$AgeGroup, levels = LABEL_ORDER)
me$Amenity  <- factor(me$Amenity,  levels = AMENITIES)
write.csv(me, file.path(out_dir, "marginal_effects_ccrem.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(transform(me[, c("Amenity", "AgeGroup", "Men", "Women", "Diff", "Diff_p")],
                Men = round(Men, 4), Women = round(Women, 4),
                Diff = round(Diff, 4), Diff_p = round(Diff_p, 3)),
      row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r me-latex}
me_tex <- c()
for (a in AMENITIES) {
  me_tex <- c(me_tex, sprintf("\\multicolumn{4}{l}{\\texttt{%s}} \\\\", gsub("_", "\\\\_", a)))
  s <- me[me$Amenity == a, ]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) {
    me_tex <- c(me_tex, sprintf("\\quad %s & %s & %s & %s%s \\\\",
                                gsub("-", "--", as.character(s$AgeGroup[i])),
                                tex_num(s$Men[i], 3), tex_num(s$Women[i], 3),
                                tex_num(s$Diff[i], 4), stars(s$Diff_p[i])))
  }
}
writeLines(me_tex, file.path(out_dir, "marginal_effects_table.tex"))
cat("Saved marginal_effects_table.tex\n")
```

## Gender difference in marginal effects (Women − Men, 95% CI)

```{r fig-me-gap, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 7}
me$lo <- me$Diff - 1.96 * me$Diff_se
me$hi <- me$Diff + 1.96 * me$Diff_se

p_gap <- ggplot(me, aes(AgeGroup, Diff, group = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(colour = "darkgreen") + geom_point(colour = "darkgreen", size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Amenity, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt3) +
  labs(x = "Age group", y = "Women \u2212 Men (minutes)") +
  theme_paper
p_gap
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "marginal_effects_gap_ccrem.png"), p_gap,
       width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Potential and realized accessibility by age group and sex

All values use the same 274-park sample as the regression. Ten-year values
are visitor-weighted over all rows in the group.

```{r descriptive}
logsumexp <- function(x) { m <- max(x); m + log(sum(exp(x - m))) }

# Potential accessibility: logsum over parks for each origin gu
pairs <- dl[!duplicated(dl[, c("ID", "INFLOW_CD")]), c("ID", "INFLOW_CD", "c_eq_min")]
for (th in c(0.05, 0.10, 0.20)) {
  A_th <- tapply(pairs$c_eq_min, pairs$INFLOW_CD, function(x) logsumexp(-th * x))
  cat(sprintf("theta = %.2f: logsum range %.3f to %.3f\n", th, min(A_th), max(A_th)))
}
A_origin <- tapply(pairs$c_eq_min, pairs$INFLOW_CD, function(x) logsumexp(-THETA * x))
dl$A_o <- A_origin[as.character(dl$INFLOW_CD)]

dl$Sex <- ifelse(dl$female == 1, "Women", "Men")
grp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(dl, list(dl$Sex, dl$age_label), drop = TRUE), function(x)
  data.frame(Sex = x$Sex[1], AgeGroup = x$age_label[1],
             A_weighted = weighted.mean(x$A_o, x$w),
             c_weighted = weighted.mean(x$c_eq_min, x$w))))
grp$AgeGroup <- factor(grp$AgeGroup, levels = LABEL_ORDER)
grp <- grp[order(grp$Sex, grp$AgeGroup), ]

gap <- data.frame(AgeGroup = factor(LABEL_ORDER, levels = LABEL_ORDER))
gap$A_gap <- grp$A_weighted[grp$Sex == "Women"] - grp$A_weighted[grp$Sex == "Men"]
gap$A_gap_minutes <- gap$A_gap / THETA
gap$c_gap <- grp$c_weighted[grp$Sex == "Women"] - grp$c_weighted[grp$Sex == "Men"]

write.csv(grp, file.path(out_dir, "group_accessibility.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gap, file.path(out_dir, "group_gaps.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(grp, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE)
print(gap, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r fig-descriptive, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4.5}
line_fig <- function(y, ylab, title) {

    scale_colour_manual(values = sex_cols) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt3) +

}

  ggplot(gap, aes(AgeGroup, .data[[y]], group = 1)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_line(colour = "darkgreen") + geom_point(colour = "darkgreen", size = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt3) +
    labs(x = "Age group", y = ylab, title = title) + theme_paper
}

figs <- list(
  "logsum accessibility by sex and age.png" =
    line_fig("A_weighted", "Logsum accessibility", "Potential accessibility by age group and sex"),
  "gender difference in accessibility.png" =
    gap_fig("A_gap", "Logsum accessibility", "Gender difference in potential accessibility (Women \u2212 Men)"),
  "travel cost by sex and age.png" =
    line_fig("c_weighted", "Mean travel cost (minutes)", "Realized travel cost by age group and sex"),
  "gender difference in travel cost.png" =
    gap_fig("c_gap", "Mean travel cost (minutes)", "Gender difference in realized travel cost (Women \u2212 Men)"))

for (f in names(figs)) {
  print(figs[[f]])
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, f), figs[[f]], width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
}
```

# 9. Robustness check: origin fixed-effects model (Appendix A)

Same fixed-effect terms, 24 origin gu dummies instead of random intercepts,
weighted least squares, standard errors clustered by park (CR1 correction).

```{r fe-model, eval = params$run_fe_model}
f_fe <- as.formula(paste("c_eq_min ~", paste(FIXED_TERMS, collapse = " + "),
                         "+ INFLOW_CD"))
fe <- lm(f_fe, data = dl, weights = w)

# Park-clustered standard errors, computed by hand (no extra package needed)
X  <- model.matrix(fe)
u  <- residuals(fe) * dl$w            # weighted residuals
XtWX_inv <- solve(crossprod(X, X * dl$w))
scores <- rowsum(X * u, group = dl$ID) # sum of x_i * w_i * e_i within each park
G <- nrow(scores); N <- nrow(X); K <- ncol(X)
meat <- crossprod(scores)
V_cl <- XtWX_inv %*% meat %*% XtWX_inv * (G / (G - 1)) * ((N - 1) / (N - K))

fe_tab <- data.frame(term = colnames(X), Estimate = coef(fe), SE = sqrt(diag(V_cl)))
fe_tab$p   <- 2 * pt(-abs(fe_tab$Estimate / fe_tab$SE), df = G - 1)
fe_tab$Sig <- stars(fe_tab$p)
fe_tab <- fe_tab[!grepl("^INFLOW_CD", fe_tab$term), ]
write.csv(fe_tab, file.path(out_dir, "fe_model_clustered.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("R2:", round(summary(fe)$r.squared, 3), "\n")
print(fe_tab[, -1], digits = 4)
```
